title: Ligustilide ameliorates cerebral ischemia-reperfusion injury by inhibiting NLRP3 inflammasome-dependent pyroptosis through enhancing Nrf2 signaling.
authors: Wang, Yang; Wan, Zhihan; Wang, Ning; Wu, Qian; Seto, Saiwang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药成分Ligustilide通过Nrf2信号抑制NLRP3炎症小体介导的焦亡来改善脑缺血再灌注损伤，属于纯湿实验与疾病机制研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Pyroptosis is a type of proinflammatory programmed cell death, that closely related to the progress of cerebral ischemia/reperfusion injury (CIRI), and NLRP3 inflammasome is the most classic pathway mediating pyroptosis. Ligustilide (LIG) is a natural compound derived from the traditional Chinese herb chuanxiong hort and angelica sinensis which can penetrate the blood-brain barrier and has a good neuroprotective effect. However, it remains unclear whether LIG could alleviate CIRI by inhibiting pyroptosis. Here, the neuroprotective effect of LIG was verified by reducing NLRP3-mediated pyroptosis, and further exploring whether the inhibition of LIG on pyroptosis was related to Nuclear factor-erythropoietin 2-related factor 2(Nrf2)activation. The results showed that LIG can reduce the injury of brain tissue after ischemia, as well as NLRP3 inflammasome-mediated pyroptosis and neuroinflammation response after MCAO/R in rats. Mechanistically, the effect of LIG on Nrf2 was detected by molecular docking, protein levels and immunofluorescence analysis. We found that LIG promoted the Nrf2 expression and reduced the production of mitochondrial ROS (mtROS), and than inhibited NLRP3 inflammasome-mediated pyroptosis. Particularly revealing was that ML385, the inhibitor of Nrf2, partly blocked the above effects of LIG. All these findings suggest that LIG may ameliorate CIRI through inhibiting NLRP3 inflammasome-mediated pyroptosis dependent on Nrf2 signaling.
abstract_zh: 细胞焦亡是一种促炎性程序性细胞死亡，与脑缺血/再灌注损伤（CIRI）的进展密切相关，而NLRP3炎症小体是介导细胞焦亡的最经典途径。藁本内酯（LIG）是一种源自传统中药川芎和当归的天然化合物，能够穿透血脑屏障，并具有良好的神经保护作用。然而，LIG是否通过抑制细胞焦亡来缓解CIRI尚不清楚。本研究通过减少NLRP3介导的细胞焦亡验证了LIG的神经保护作用，并进一步探讨LIG对细胞焦亡的抑制是否与核因子-红细胞2相关因子2（Nrf2）的激活有关。结果表明，LIG能够减轻大鼠缺血后脑组织损伤，以及MCAO/R后NLRP3炎症小体介导的细胞焦亡和神经炎症反应。在机制上，通过分子对接、蛋白水平和免疫荧光分析检测了LIG对Nrf2的作用。我们发现LIG促进了Nrf2的表达，减少了线粒体活性氧（mtROS）的产生，并进而抑制了NLRP3炎症小体介导的细胞焦亡。特别值得注意的是，Nrf2抑制剂ML385部分阻断了LIG的上述效应。所有研究结果表明，LIG可能通过依赖Nrf2信号通路抑制NLRP3炎症小体介导的细胞焦亡来改善CIRI。
